description: Which institution is this? A name fragment or an IPEDS UNITID answers with the institution's identity, sector, identifiers with their sources, and how many programs, checklists, and learning units its published catalog holds here. A state lists that state's institutions by name; with no name and no state, the answer is the states that hold institutions, each with its count.

city.description: Optional city, one of a state answer's cities, e.g. Denison

offset.description: Optional: the next_offset from a previous answer

query.description: Name fragment or IPEDS UNITID, e.g. Denver or 127060

state.description: Optional two-letter state, e.g. TX: that state's institutions, those with a catalog held first; the answer lists the state's cities

name: find_institution
title: Find Institution
